x-truebex-scopes.description: Open projects and read their operations, snapshots, versions, members, presence and jobs.
Create and rename projects, push operations, register snapshots, name and restore versions, invite.
Submit and cancel render jobs, the presentation pack among them.
Upload bundles and publish, list, change and revoke shares.
Read the catalogue with the key's limits instead of the anonymous ones.
Send a supplier's catalogue feed and read its import reports.
Register webhook endpoints, read deliveries, re-send them and rotate secrets.

x-truebex-webhook-events.description: Operations were accepted (one event per 30 s per project: first and last numbers, authors).
Someone was invited to a project.
A render job of the account succeeded.
A render job of the account failed.
Yesterday's visits to the account's shares (00:10 UTC).
An order or request for quote of the account changed state.
A catalogue feed run of the account's supplier ended.

x-truebex-webhooks.signature: Standard Webhooks: webhook-id, webhook-timestamp, webhook-signature (v1, HMAC-SHA256)
